title: Factory Method participants
purpose: Explain creator algorithm invokes overridable factory method returning product abstraction.
alt: Creator가 factoryMethod를 호출하고 ConcreteCreator가 ConcreteProduct를 생성하는 일반 구조
requiredChecks: Creator.factoryMethod(): Product and anOperation() uses product=factoryMethod().
ConcreteCreator extends Creator and overrides factoryMethod returning new ConcreteProduct().
Creator uses Product abstraction; ConcreteCreator creates ConcreteProduct; inheritance directions not reversed.
